title: Reefs to Rivers Fishing Charters

services.name: View Charter
services.desc: Captain Carlos can put you on the iguanas! Help put a dent in this invasive species humanely & legally. Don't just book with anyone, book with a U.S.C.G licensed and insured Captain who has the knowledge and skill to take these beauties down the right way. Our private Iguana Charters take place aboard a 24' Action craft Coastal Bay . We use a .22 caliber air rifle with a scope as well as a noose to hunt the iguanas. This boat is powered by a Yamaha 150hp engine. The boat is equipped with Garmin Electronics and a Minn Kota trolling motor. This hunting/fishing charter service is very family oriented and welcomes all ages and groups. Our recommended minimum age to utilize our air rifles is 10
